servers.description: A comprehensive MCP server providing 35 tools for monitoring and managing multiple Syncthing file synchronization instances. It enables users to track sync status, manage device connections, and modify folder configurations through natural language commands.

TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode: streamable-http, sse, or stdio

SERVER_HOST.description: The host the server should bind to

SERVER_PORT.description: The port the server should listen on

SYNCTHING_URL.description: The URL of the Syncthing instance (e.g., http://localhost:8384)

SYNCTHING_API_KEY.description: The API key for the Syncthing instance

SYNCTHING_INSTANCES.description: Configuration for multiple Syncthing instances in the format: server1|http://host1:8384|key1,server2|http://host2:8384|key2

servers.name: Syncthing MCP Server

servers.description: Provides browser automation capabilities for LLMs using Playwright, leveraging structured accessibility snapshots to interact with web pages without needing vision models. It enables tasks like web navigation, data extraction, and automated testing through a lightweight and deterministic toolset.

caps.description: Comma-separated list of capabilities to enable (tabs, pdf, history, wait, files, install). Default is all.

host.description: Host to bind server to. Default is localhost.

port.description: Port to listen on for SSE transport

config.description: Path to the JSON configuration file

vision.description: Run server that uses screenshots instead of accessibility snapshots (set to 'true' to enable)

browser.description: Browser or chrome channel to use. Possible values: chrome, firefox, webkit, msedge, chrome-beta, chrome-canary, chrome-dev, msedge-beta, msedge-canary, msedge-dev. Default: chrome

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (set to 'true' to enable, headed by default)

user-data-dir.description: Path to the user data directory

allowed-origins.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins to allow the browser to request.

blocked-origins.description: Semicolon-separated list of origins to block the browser to request.

servers.name: Playwright MCP

servers.description: An MCP server that exposes structured Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) to enable AI assistants like GitHub Copilot to automatically generate complete NestJS boilerplate architectures. It orchestrates the multi-phase creation of production-ready APIs including core CRUD, database integration, JWT authentication, and unit testing.
servers.name: FRD Orchestrator

servers.description: An MCP server that leverages the Microsoft Edge TTS service to provide high-quality text-to-speech capabilities across over 80 languages. It enables users to generate audio files, query available voices, and create subtitle files using natural language commands.

PYTHONPATH.description: Environment variable to ensure Python can find source code, typically pointing to the 'src' directory of the edge-tts installation.

servers.name: Edge-TTS MCP Server

servers.description: Provides LLMs with full PostgreSQL database access, including tools for query execution, schema management, and data export. It also features a dedicated insights system for storing business memos and supports both local stdio and remote HTTP transport.
servers.name: General-Purpose MCP Database Server

servers.description: An MCP server and VS Code extension that enables users to fetch and browse 4D command documentation with integrated caching. It allows AI assistants to retrieve detailed technical content and open documentation links directly for 4D development support.
servers.name: 4D Documentation Viewer

servers.description: A local MCP server that allows AI systems to search and retrieve information from a custom knowledge base generated from markdown files. It provides tools for natural language text search, category browsing, and specific content chunk retrieval.
servers.name: Knowledge Base MCP Server

servers.description: Automatically enhances user prompts by applying expert-level prompt engineering techniques tailored to technical, creative, or analytical content types. It provides visual feedback on applied optimizations to ensure higher quality, structured, and more comprehensive AI responses.
servers.name: AI Validation MCP Server

servers.description: Generates daily GitHub work summaries by analyzing commits across all repositories a user owns or contributes to. It provides tools to fetch today's commit activity and deduplicate repository-specific updates for easy reporting.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope

servers.name: GitHub Summary MCP

servers.description: Enables comprehensive interaction with IMAP email accounts through 38 tools for reading, searching, and organizing messages. It supports advanced features like real-time mailbox monitoring via IDLE watch and automated email archiving.
servers.name: IMAP MCP Server

servers.description: Enables Claude Code to interact with Obsidian vaults by providing tools for multi-term searching, reading notes, and exploring tag-based relationships. It allows users to query, analyze, and manage their personal knowledge base directly through natural language.
servers.name: Knowledge Assistant MCP Server

servers.description: Integrates with the Turkish Revenue Administration (GİB) e-Arşiv Fatura system to manage e-invoices via natural language. Users can list, search, create, and cancel invoices, as well as validate Turkish tax numbers and retrieve UBL-TR format XML data.

GIB_PASSWORD.description: Your password for the GİB e-Arşiv portal.

GIB_USERNAME.description: Your VKN (Tax Identification Number) or TCKN (Identity Number) for the GİB e-Arşiv Fatura system.

GIB_ENVIRONMENT.description: The GİB API environment to target (e.g., 'test' for the test portal or 'production' for the live portal).

servers.name: e-Fatura MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server for read-only Linux system administration and diagnostics on RHEL-based systems via SSH. It enables users to troubleshoot remote hosts by accessing system information, services, logs, and network configurations through natural language.
servers.name: Linux MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI assistants to manage database migrations and validate schemas using the Ariga Atlas CLI. It provides tools for applying migrations, generating diffs, linting, and checking migration status through natural language.
servers.name: MCP Atlas

servers.description: Enables users to organize, search, and manage a shared library of prompts across AI tools via the Model Context Protocol. It supports hierarchical folder organization, tagging, and template variable substitution for dynamic prompt generation.
servers.name: Prompt Bookmarks

servers.description: This MCP server verifies that an agent’s claimed tool output matches the actual response returned by a tool to prevent invented or distorted results. It flags mismatches, omissions, and invented fields to ensure downstream logic only processes verified tool data.
servers.name: Tool Response Suppressor (MCP)

servers.description: A lightweight stdio-to-http relay that enables the GitHub MCP server to authenticate using a GitHub App instead of a Personal Access Token. It automatically manages fine-grained permissions and short-lived tokens for secure, organizational AI agent workflows.

GH_CLIENT_ID.description: Found on the General settings page of your GitHub App (e.g., Iv23liABC123).

GH_REMOTE_MCP_URL.description: The remote MCP endpoint URL to relay to. Defaults to https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp.

GH_INSTALLATION_ID.description: The numeric string at the end of the installation URL (e.g., 12345678).

GH_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.description: The absolute path to the .pem private key file generated and downloaded from the GitHub App's General settings page.

servers.name: GitHub MCP App Shim

servers.description: Enables integration between Claude AI and Nasuni environments to monitor appliance health, manage volumes and shares, and generate comprehensive infrastructure reports. Users can interact with the Nasuni Management Center through natural language to track performance metrics and summarize system notifications.

DEBUG.description: Set to true for development and detailed logging

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level for the server (e.g., DEBUG, INFO)

VERIFY_SSL.description: SSL Verification (set to true for production)

NMC_USERNAME.description: NMC login username. For domain accounts use DOMAIN\username.

servers.name: Nasuni Management MCP Server

servers.description: Enables LLMs to explore and analyze UK Government BEIS inspect_ai evaluation logs directly from tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It provides capabilities to list logs, view evaluation summaries, and inspect conversation histories for specific samples.
servers.name: inspect-logs-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server that enables users to manage, search, and apply specialized AI personas within Claude Desktop and Claude Code CLI. It features a local-first architecture with YAML-based storage for organizing curated prompts and role collections.
servers.name: Claude Role Library

servers.description: Enables users to search for high-quality photos on Unsplash with support for advanced filtering by orientation and content safety. It provides formatted photo metadata and images in either base64-encoded format or as JSON with URLs via stdio transport.

access-key.description: Unsplash API access key, provided as a command-line argument.

response-format.description: The response format for the server. Options are 'text' (returns JSON with URLs) or the default image format (base64-encoded images).

UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY.description: Unsplash API access key, provided as an environment variable.

servers.name: Unsplash MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server and web application that enables natural language medical queries and patient data analysis powered by Gemini AI. It allows users to track and analyze patient biometrics, including vitals, sleep patterns, and laboratory results, through a comprehensive set of automated medical tools.

MEDICAL_MODEL.description: The AI model to use for medical queries (e.g., gemini).

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Your Google Gemini API key required for professional medical insights.

DISPLAY_TIMEZONE.description: The timezone for displaying medical records and analysis.

servers.name: Intelligent Medical Assistant

servers.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides persistent storage, categorization, and retrieval of bookmarks through AI clients like Claude. It allows users to manage web links using custom categories and includes options for local JSON storage or AWS S3 synchronization.
servers.name: Bookmark Manager MCP

servers.description: Enables vision capabilities for any AI model by routing image analysis requests through OpenRouter's vision models. It provides tools to analyze images from URLs, local file paths, or base64 data.
servers.name: Vision MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that integrates with the Zerodha KiteConnect API to facilitate programmatic stock trading operations. It enables users to execute buy and sell commands directly through an MCP-compatible interface.

API_KEY.description: Your Zerodha Developer App API key.

API_SECRET.description: Your Zerodha Developer App API secret.

servers.name: Zerodha Trading MCP Server
